# Faction Atlas — full index

> Compact index of published factions, organizations, people, and issues. A sourced, neutral reference map of American political and religious-political factions, the people and organizations in them, and how they relate, with every claim linked to a public source.

License: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). See [llms.txt](https://factionatlas.github.io/llms.txt) for the site map and data files.

## Issues

- ["Heritage Americans"](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/heritage-americans/) — The idea that descendants of the country's founding-era stock are a distinct group with a special claim.

- [Abortion law](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/abortion-law/) — Where abortion law should be set and how restrictive it should be (a national limit, state-by-state, or legal access).
- [Abortion pills](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/abortion-pills/) — Rules on mifepristone and mailed abortion pills.
- [Affirmative action](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/affirmative-action/) — Race-conscious admissions and hiring.
- [AI regulation](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/ai-regulation/) — Government rules for artificial intelligence, including state AI laws.
- [Antitrust and Big Tech](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/antitrust-big-tech/) — Using antitrust law against large tech firms.
- [Asylum and refugees](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/asylum-refugees/) — Asylum rules and refugee admissions.
- [Birthright citizenship](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/birthright-citizenship/) — Whether children born in the U.S.
- [Bitcoin factions](https://factionatlas.github.io/issues/bitcoin/) — Positions inside Bitcoin culture, independent of political faction: a Christian nationalist and a libertarian can share a Bitcoin faction.
